sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 ASR — real-time streaming speech-to-text
sources.snippet: Self-hosted, GPU-accelerated streaming speech recognition built on nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-.6b — a multilingual (40 language-locales) cache-aware FastConformer-RNNT model. It ships as two containers: a FastAPI inference server on your GPU and a small web UI, so you can open a page on your phone or laptop and watch words appear as you speak. Clone it and run one script.
